title: MOCK TRIAL OF FORMER PRESIDENT HASSAN ROUHANI AND EX-FOREIGN MINISTER MOHAMMAD JAVAD ZARIF HELD AT NIGHTLY GATHERING IN TEHRAN
text:
MOCK TRIAL OF FORMER PRESIDENT HASSAN ROUHANI AND EX-FOREIGN MINISTER MOHAMMAD JAVAD ZARIF HELD AT NIGHTLY GATHERING IN TEHRAN"

"🔆🔅A mock street trial targeting former President Hassan Rouhani and former Foreign Minister Mohammad Javad Zarif was staged during a nightly public gathering, according to video footage circulated on social media."

"The event, described by organizers as a “people’s trial”, featured a makeshift courtroom setup in an open outdoor space, complete with an Iranian flag and banners displaying portraits of Rouhani and Zarif. Three participants assumed the roles of judge, prosecutor, and defendant, with the individual portraying Rouhani seated on a chair and holding a mask bearing the former president’s likeness."

"The prosecutor read a statement addressed to the presiding “judge,” alleging that public trust in officials has been damaged and that the policies of the previous administration require judicial accountability. Organizers displayed a banner titled “People’s Trial of Hassan Rouhani and Zarif,” framing the symbolic action as a response to the policies and decisions of Iran’s 11th and 12th governments."

"The primary accusations directed at Rouhani and Zarif center on the 2015 nuclear agreement, known as the Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action (JCPOA). Critics argue that the deal failed to deliver anticipated economic benefits and left Iran in a vulnerable position. The symbolic prosecution asserts that Rouhani and Zarif, as the key architects of the agreement, must be held accountable for what is characterized as “damage to national interests” and “weakening of the economy and foreign relations”."

"The event reflects internal tensions within political establishment, where hardline factions have persistently called for legal action against Rouhani and Zarif. The exact time and location of the gathering have not been disclosed."
